title: Unlimited bookings
body: However many land in a month, the price does not move.

title: Unlimited event types
body: A different length, location and set of rules for each one.

title: Calendar conflict checks
body: Every connected calendar is read before a time is offered.

title: Time-zone detection
body: Visitors see their own hours, and the zone we picked for them.

title: Buffers and daily limits
body: Minimum notice, a gap either side, and a cap on the day.

title: Reschedule and cancel links
body: In every invite, so nobody has to email you about it.

title: Thirty languages
body: Chosen by the visitor's browser, changeable by hand.

title: Embeds and an API
body: Inline, popup or behind a button, and a REST API underneath.
